svg.aria-label: rvn ask "why did customers get charged twice"

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: $ rvn ask "why did customers get charged twice"

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: Customers were charged twice because retried `payment_intent.succeeded` webhooks were processed twice.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: The webhook handler lacked an idempotency check, so the replay created a second order; it was fixed

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: by storing a unique `stripe_event_id` and skipping already processed events. [#2] [#1]
